definitions.explanation: The state of being recently married, or a recently married person or couple. Typically refers to the first year or so of marriage.

examples.japanese: {新婚|しんこん}{旅行|りょこう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧ハワイ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}った→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: We went to Hawaii on our honeymoon.

examples.japanese: {新婚|しんこん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{二人|ふたり}→二人：00622_futari⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦とても→とても：00593_totemo⟧{幸|しあわ}せそうだ。
examples.english: The newlywed couple looks very happy.

examples.japanese: {新婚|しんこん}⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{楽|たの}しい→楽しい：00817_tanoshii⟧こと⟦ばかり→〜ばかり：02006_bakari⟧⟦ではなく→ではなく：09578_dehanaku⟧、⟦お{互|たが}い→お互い：00336_otagai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{合|あ}わせる→合わせる：01872_awaseru⟧こと⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: Newlywed life isn't all fun — there are many things you need to adjust to each other on.

notes:
USAGE:
Most commonly used as a modifier with ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ or in compound nouns. The phrase {新婚|しんこん}{旅行|りょこう} (honeymoon trip) is extremely common. {新婚|しんこん}ほやほや is a colloquial expression meaning "freshly newlywed" or "just married."

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {新婚|しんこん}{旅行|りょこう}: honeymoon
- {新婚|しんこん}⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧: newlywed life
- {新婚|しんこん}⟦{夫婦|ふうふ}→夫婦：03592_fuufu⟧: newlywed couple
- {新婚|しんこん}ほやほや: freshly married

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{新郎|しんろう}{新婦|しんぷ}→新郎新婦：28965_shinroushinpu⟧: bride and groom (specifically at the wedding)
